lines.text: Google's Search & other revenue grew from $149 billion in 2021 to $224.5 billion in 2025.
lines.say: That line grew from about a hundred forty-nine billion dollars in twenty twenty-one to two hundred twenty-four point five billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: $224.5 billion ÷ 365 days = about $615 million a day, or about $7,120 every second.
lines.say: Divide that by three hundred sixty-five days and Google earns about six hundred fifteen million dollars a day from search, or about seven thousand one hundred twenty dollars every second.

lines.text: April to June 2026: Search & other rose 17% to $63.3 billion.
lines.say: And from April to June twenty twenty-six, it rose seventeen percent, to sixty-three point three billion dollars.

lines.text: The surprise: Google paid Apple about $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default search.
lines.say: The surprising part? Google paid Apple about twenty billion dollars in twenty twenty-two to be Safari's default search engine.

lines.text: In September 2025, a judge barred exclusive deals but let Google keep paying for placement.
lines.say: In September twenty twenty-five, a federal judge barred exclusive deals like that, but let Google keep paying for placement.

Free Google Search made $224.5 billion in 2025.

That's Google's Search & other revenue in Alphabet's 2025 annual report, about $615 million a day.

Google paid Apple about $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default search engine.
